title: Linear-size encoding
statement: For a natural number $n$ and a Boolean list $z$, encode the pair consisting of the second decoded component of $z$ and the concatenation of two true bits with the result of multiplying, in unary, the encoding of the list of $n$ true bits and the unary head of the first decoded component of $z$. Then multiply this encoded list in unary.
caveat: The pairing, unary multiplication, and unary-head operations are not defined in the supplied definitions, so their precise constructions cannot be rendered in standard mathematical terms.
